Indeed, after embedding the declared number field into \(\mathbb C\), the submitted map would be a polynomial local biholomorphism
\[
F:\mathbb C^3\to\mathbb C^3,\qquad \det JF=c\ne0,
\]
with at least four distinct points in one fiber. Thus \(F\) would be noninjective, contrary to the Jacobian conjecture, already in dimension three and degree at most eleven.

The complex Jacobian conjecture remains open, and no such explicit map is known. The degree bound and algebraic witnesses do not avoid this equivalence. Consequently, no truthful `FINAL_CERTIFICATE_JSON` can currently be supplied; any purported one would constitute a new counterexample resolving the conjecture.
